scope: Static helper logic only; verifier not executed by reviewer. No build acceptance.
sound_checks: Runner verifies exact21 source inputs and pinned Dhaga PDF before and after every stage; resumed prior stages must match contract and pass. Thirteen stage order/results required by final verifier.

Contract contains actual article paragraphs, seven references/five notes, six source URLs, image hashes, three expected dimensions, protected manifest and capacity candidate. It is an expectation, not proof.

Verifier checks actual article paragraphs in each edition, native note/return targets, source/credit links, sharing identity, local article parity, three unique incoming links, protected113 hashes, three foreign pointers, PDF bytes and strict stat-summed payload.
Dedicated coastal/publication exclusions inspect file paths, text and protected same-size hashes; full internal edition is not incorrectly forbidden.

required_before_package_acceptance.finding: Variant dimensions currently read only from generator report. Decode actual base and three emitted variants and assert dimensions/orientation against explicit expectations.

Assert KB original Sahi hash as well as public/full/coast originals. Compare actual affected Sahi article across editions with only bounded existing publication transformations allowed; retain other image/caption and article text. Current hash/credit/OG checks alone do not establish that preservation.
Add exact opening prose markers for Godabarish/Niankhunta and Kaincha to both dedicated export scans. Paths/titles/whole-file hashes alone can miss renamed partial body export.
Check exact card title/summary and actual emitted responsive mapping, plus expected search hold and robots behavior. Current preview check covers only image src/alt and credits.

limits: These are supplementary evidence helper corrections; no demonstrated public-source defect or weakening of current full release suite.
Independent final artifact and browser review remain necessary.
Helpers must not be reported as passed until actual successful execution after all stages.
